name: UP Post-Matric (Dashmottar) Scholarship — SC / ST Students
provider: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: Uttar Pradesh's flagship post-matric scholarship for SC/ST students from Class XI to PhD, covering maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement through the state scholarship portal.

benefit.details: Course-group-wise maintenance allowance (day scholar / hosteller rates) plus reimbursement of enrolment & tuition fees via DBT.

special_conditions: SC/ST certificate issued in Uttar Pradesh
Enrolled in a recognised institution with the portal dashboard entry
Institute type and course group decide the exact slab

steps: Fill the Dashmottar form and select SC/ST category
Upload documents and submit to institute

name: UP Post-Matric (Dashmottar) Scholarship — OBC / General / Minority / EWS Students
provider: Backward Class Welfare / Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: Post-matric scholarship on the UP portal for OBC, economically weaker General-category and minority-community students studying Class XI and above.

benefit.details: Course-group-wise maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement, DBT-credited.

special_conditions: OBC (non-creamy-layer) certificate of UP for OBC; EWS/income certificate for General; community certificate for minority applicants
Income caps are notified per cycle — re-verify the current slab

steps: Choose OBC / General / Minority scheme line

notes: Income slabs for OBC/General/minority lines changed in recent cycles; re-verify each admission season.

name: UP Pre-Matric Scholarship (Class 9 – 10)
provider: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: State pre-matric scholarship for Class 9 and 10 students from lower-income families of Uttar Pradesh, aimed at cutting dropouts before the board years.

benefit.details: Annual maintenance allowance credited by DBT after school verification.

special_conditions: Studying in a recognised UP school in Class 9 or 10
Income certificate within the notified limit

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
provider: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: Conditional cash support for UP girls across six life-stage milestones — the final tranche pays ₹15,000 on admission to a degree course or a 2+ year diploma.

benefit.amount_display: ₹15,000 at college admission (final stage; cumulative up to ~₹25,000 over stages)
benefit.details: Stage-wise DBT transfers from birth through graduation admission; the education-linked stage is the largest.

deadline.label: Rolling — apply in the stage window

special_conditions: Maximum two daughters per family (selective waivers notified)
Each stage has its own application window and proof (birth, K1/K6/K9 admission, +2/graduation admission)
College-admission stage requires proof of admission to a degree or 2+ year diploma

documents: Admission proof for the relevant stage

steps: Select the applicable stage and upload proof

name: Rani Lakshmibai Mahila Samman Kosh (Uttar Pradesh)
provider: Department of Women Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: One-time assistance of ₹25,000 for women of eligible UP households — usable for higher education or marriage — for families whose income is within the notified limit.

benefit.details: One-time Samman Kosh payment; applicants may cite higher education or marriage as the purpose.

special_conditions: Applicant / family income within the notified ceiling
BPL/destitute/widow/divorced/abandoned categories get priority under the guidelines
Not simultaneously drawing another state grant for the same purpose

steps: Collect/apply via the district women welfare office or portal window

notes: Windows open district-wise and guidelines shift — flagged pending review.

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana — Free Competitive-Exam Coaching (Uttar Pradesh)
summary: Free residential/non-residential coaching for UPSC, UPPCS, JEE, NEET, CLAT and other competitive exams at state Abhyudaya centres — a value-in-kind scholarship for UP aspirants from modest households.

benefit.amount_display: Free coaching (indicative value ₹30,000+) at state centres
benefit.details: Coaching, mentoring and study material at Abhyudaya centres; both online and offline batches.

special_conditions: BPL card holders and lower-income families get priority
Duration/subsistence support depends on the exam and batch
Seats allocated via registration + counselling at the centre

steps: Register for the target exam batch
Document check at the district level

notes: Value-in-kind (coaching) rather than cash — benefit amount is indicative.
